name: Deposit-bet-withdraw money laundering
description: Player deposits, places minimal-stake bets, withdraws to a different / clean payment instrument.

name: Third-party deposits / withdrawals
description: Account funded by, or withdrawn to, a third party — high AML risk.

name: High-value player without SoF
description: Player meets high-value threshold without source-of-funds documentation.

name: Sanctioned / PEP player
description: Player matches sanctions or PEP list and account is operated.

name: Multi-accounting / bonus abuse / mule ring
description: Same individual operates multiple accounts to exploit bonuses or launder funds via mule ring.

name: Operating outside licensed jurisdiction
description: Players from jurisdictions not covered by operator's licence.
